_comment: Git host for sprintkit skills that open, read, review or merge PRs/MRs (autopilot, loop, implement, review, sync, pipeline, retro). Delete this file to auto-detect the host from the origin remote. No credentials here: log in with the CLI (gh auth login or glab auth login).
_provider: auto, github or gitlab. auto reads the origin remote: github.com is github, gitlab.com or a name containing gitlab is gitlab. A self-hosted server with an unrevealing name must be set explicitly.
_host: Optional. Bare hostname of a self-hosted server, e.g. gitlab.mycompany.com (no https://, no path; add :port if non-standard). Leave empty for github.com or gitlab.com. It must match the host of the origin remote.
